value.account:
What changed. State/selection: RunState.result_persistence_profile (validated, omitted when absent), StateManager.initialize(result_persistence_profile=), the four atomic eligible-pure visit/settle methods on StateManager and on the call-frame manager, load_existing_call_frame_read_only plus the 'existing call-frame state' rejection, profile selection in calls.py from the callee bundle's frontend_kind (iteration-owned frames, existing frames and non-WL callees stay historical), and run / resume --force-restart selecting the profile (force-restart no longer rewrites the source run's state to apply observability overrides; they seed the new root). New modules orchestrator/workflow/pure_result_replay{,_witness,_index,_types,_surfaces}.py (facade re-exports every named symbol): witness/shell/classify, index derivation with typed addresses and strict literal typing (including inactive union members), PureReplayRuntime (cache with per-hit revalidation, overlay, required-node/leaf audits, surface-conflict audit). Executor: pure begin/settle for eligible nodes via _persist_step_result and OutcomeRecorder(eligible_pure_settlement=), no bundle I/O for eligible nodes, pre-prologue conflict/progress audit, in-memory replay before the default-resume decision, restart boundary computed once and passed to ResumePlanner.determine_default_resume_decision(restart_node_id=), provider observation manager created at execute() start. Checkpoints: eligible pure points emit no record, derivable bindings are not captured, eligible points are filtered before nearest-prior selection, and the VALIDATED_FRAME_ENTRY_REPLAY zero-record case (fail closed with lexical_default_resume_prior_boundary_not_restorable otherwise). Docs: specs/state.md section and a capability-matrix row. Tests: three new modules (state/shell, index, end-to-end resume) and two existing observation tests updated because they asserted manager creation at construction, which the spec now forbids.

Alternatives considered/discarded: persisting pure values in a sidecar (defeats the profile); replaying all completed eligible nodes instead of only required ones (simpler, but fails resume on unneeded nodes and contradicts required_pure_node_ids); an executor-level wrapper signature change for _determine_resume_default_resume_decision (kept single-arg and read the memoized boundary so existing seams still work); putting visit-two handling in the planner (kept it in classification so it is rejected before the prologue).

Not covered / uncertain: the spec leaves several shapes open, so I guessed: binding.path begins with the binding name, output_addresses is a tuple, evaluate_node / resolve_bundle_path receive a str-subclass node key (also exposes step_id/presentation_key), load_existing_call_frame_read_only returns a RunState, scope_kind other than 'root' is always a mismatch (expected_scope = requested, actual_scope = 'root'), and the 'unbound text' rule rejects literal strings containing '${'. Resuming a node whose pure row is a durable failure fails closed (progress_witness_invalid) instead of re-running it. Resume through a failed call boundary into a profiled child frame is still blocked by the pre-existing default-resume fail-closed behavior (unchanged from baseline), so child-frame replay was only checked for fresh runs and frame selection. Full suite: 138 failures, all of which fail identically on an untouched HEAD copy (provider-isolation/socket/tmux/golden environment issues); nothing was committed.
value.summary: Added the derived_pure_replay.v1 profile: eligible pure projections persist only an exact value-free shell and resume rebuilds their values in memory, with new tests passing and no new failures in the full suite.
